title: Undo it on the way out
hints: The constructor already remembers the old value. It also has to change the target.
Add a destructor, `~ScopedValue()`, that writes `m_old` back into `m_target`.
Write `ScopedValue(const ScopedValue&) = delete;` and the same for `operator=` to forbid copies.
lessonTitle: Object Lifetime: When Memory Is Valid
